name: brain
description: Project registry and tracker context, guards, model routing, lazy MCP, STE output style. Shared by researcher and builder.

context_dir.title: Context directory
context_dir.description: The context/ folder that holds registry.json, projects/ and library/.

main_model.title: Main loop model
main_model.description: The model the main loop (the orchestrator) always runs on. Empty: no override.

subagent_model.title: Subagent model
subagent_model.description: The model for subagents when the Agent call and context/routing.json name none.

guard_context_percent.title: Context guard (%)
guard_context_percent.description: Main-loop context fill at which the orchestrator is told to save progress and hand off to a fresh session.

guard_window_percent.title: Usage window guard (%)
guard_window_percent.description: Rate-limit window use at which the orchestrator is told to spawn one agent at a time.
